name: streamify-desktop
description: Streamify Desktop - Electron wrapper for streamifyweb-player with in-process streamifyapi
author: Streamify

scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently -k -n api,next,electron "node scripts/dev-api.mjs" "npm run dev --prefix app" "wait-on tcp:7861 tcp:3000 && electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:app
scripts.start: npm run start:api & npm run start:app && electron . --prod
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable
